name: Zuñiga (2020): ΔpheA rescue
fluxUnits: mmol gDW⁻¹ h⁻¹ (original model flux basis)

license.authorsRepository: No explicit redistribution license at pinned revision
license.distribution: Original MAT files and full converted models are downloaded and cached privately on the user's device; neither is redistributed by Coxeter.

formulation.method: Stationary FBA, maximize the original c vector
formulation.monoculture: M-models.mat SingleM{4}, all source bounds unchanged
formulation.coculture: CM-modelsKO.mat modelCo2{2}, all source bounds unchanged
formulation.sharedPool: The authors' original stoichiometric shared metabolite pool; no abundance normalization or equal-growth coupling

reproduction.scope: The ΔpheA stationary predictions in Supplementary Data 9; not all of the article's experiments or OptCom framework
limitations: WT monoculture is a calculation with the published source model, not a reported experimental growth rate.
The MAT files identify iJO1366/iJB785; the article names iML1515/iJB792. File identities and dimensions are retained rather than silently substituted.
The public LiveScript calls optimizeCbModel with the saved objective, although Methods discusses OptCom; a separate OptCom optimizer is not reproduced.
Source Data Fig.4b pheA values conflict with Supplementary Data 9 and the article text. Data 9 is the explicit numerical reference.
The source medium allows low glucose and citrate uptake. It is not described as a carbon-free numerical medium.
The original PFL grRules text is malformed. The valid original indexed rules field is translated with identical gene associations.
The first model download requires internet; subsequent loads use the private browser cache or a personal reproducibility export.
